Application Data.NAME: Petal Paradise Florists
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Petal Paradise Florists specializes in the retail sale of fresh and artificial floral arrangements, providing customized floral design services for weddings and corporate events. Our operations include maintaining a brick-and-mortar storefront equipped with comprehensive fire protection systems and climate-controlled storage for perishable inventory. We prioritize sustainability by using eco-friendly materials and strictly adhere to industry regulations regarding pesticide use. Additionally, our delivery services are managed with documented risk controls, ensuring secure packaging and safety assessments for off-premises installations. Our commitment to quality and customer satisfaction has resulted in a positive claims history, emphasizing our focus on product sales and reliable service delivery.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 06/15/2023, we experienced a loss due to a refrigeration failure in our climate-controlled storage, resulting in damage to floral inventory. The estimated loss amount was $1,500. The claim has been settled, and the inventory was replaced with minimal disruption to operations.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Commercial Grade Safe, UL Listed, Class 350, Fire and Burglary Rated
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security cameras and motion sensor alarms monitored by a central station; staff trained in emergency response procedures.
